//: Dev push's path rules (docs/DEV-PUSH.md 4.2, 4.5, 9.1, 9.4), read by every side that makes or checks a dev bundle: @phoenix/platform's devpush.js (the nova command, org.webosphoenix.nova on a device, Phoenix-Web-Services' checks follow it), tools/install-rootfs.py (the image's manifest.json lists only the files these rules let a bundle change).

mounts: the five directories a developer overlay covers; nothing outside them is ever changed. refused: inside them, never in a bundle (a prefix ending in / is a directory, else one file): the trust anchors, com.palm.update (so a pushed file can never stop the update that clears the overlay), org.webosphoenix.nova itself, and the image's own manifest. refusedPatterns: the same for files matched by a regular expression (the two services' Luna files).

parts: what part of the system a path belongs to, the first prefix that matches (a granted developer key names the parts it may change, 9.1). compiled: checkout folders built into binaries a bundle cannot carry (section 10): a change there needs an image.
maxBundleBytes: 64 MB per bundle (decision 9); maxOverlayBytes: the overlay's cap on a device (decision 10, a setting there); maxUnpackedBytes: what a bundle may unpack to at most.
